threads.body: The Quarkus Gradle plugin version (3.37.4) and the enforced platform BOM version (3.38.0) are out of sync. This can lead to dependency alignment issues and build/runtime incompatibilities. Align them to the same Quarkus release series (e.g., set the BOM to 3.37.4, or bump the plugin to the matching 3.38.x if that’s the intended target).
